title: Jepsen: etcd 3.4.3
summary: Jepsen tested etcd 3.4.3 for safety under network partitions and process crashes. The key-value operations of etcd appeared to be strictly serializable in these tests.

key_points.claim: Jepsen tested etcd 3.4.3 for safety under network partitions and process crashes
key_points.quote: Jepsen tested etcd 3.4.3 for safety under network partitions and process crashes.

key_points.claim: The key-value operations of etcd appeared to be strictly serializable in these tests

key_points.claim: The analysis found that etcd locks are not safe for mutual exclusion
